_id: best rung: best007 with estimator.integerAmbiguity.enable turned ON. best007 is the first configuration in this work whose undifferenced uplink ambiguity sits inside the fixing gate (0.0080 m = 0.066 cycles against maxSigma_cycles 0.15), and estimator.integerAmbiguity has been false on all 108 rungs of the frozen sweep. This rung cashes that, or finds out why it cannot be cashed.
_delta: estimator.integerAmbiguity.enable true (was false). ONE leaf. The four gates keep their masterConfig values -- minArcLength_s 300, maxSigma_cycles 0.15, maxDistanceToInteger_cycles 0.20, maxResidualRmsIncrease_m 0.01 -- because a rung that both enables a feature and loosens its acceptance criteria cannot say which produced the result.
_WHATTHEFIXERACTUALLYIS: cfg.estimator.integerAmbiguity is PER-AMBIGUITY ROUNDING in mode controlledRawCarrier, and masterConfig calls it 'the weakest integer estimator' in its own comment. It is NOT LAMBDA: there is no ILS search, no bootstrapped success rate and no ratio test, which is exactly the false-fix protection the LAMBDA block was written to add and which is unavailable here because the TU Delft toolbox is not vendored. So a fix accepted by this rung is accepted on a distance-to-integer threshold alone. Report it as controlled rounding, never as PPP-grade ambiguity resolution -- summary.stage63PppGradeClaim exists and stays false.
_THEBINDINGGATEISNOTSIGMA: best007 clears maxSigma_cycles 0.15 with 0.066 and clears minArcLength_s 300 on a 3600 s arc. The gate that decides this rung is maxDistanceToInteger_cycles = 0.20, and errors.interAntennaCarrierBias injects 0.25 cycles per (tower, antenna) with estimator.interAntennaCarrierBias.mode 'none', so nothing corrects it and the ambiguity absorbs it. carr016 measured the resulting fractional part as indistinguishable from uniform: std 0.2923 cycles against 0.2887 for a true uniform.
_THEPREDICTION: CarrierMeasurementBuilder gates the inter-antenna bias on antenna index > 1, so antenna 1 carries no per-antenna bias and its ambiguity truth should be lambda*N. That is 5 towers x 2 signals = 10 of the 40 ambiguities. Antennas 2, 3 and 4 carry the uncorrected 0.25-cycle bias and should be rejected by the distance gate. PREDICTED OUTCOME: classification 'active-fixed-raw-carrier' with roughly 10 accepted and roughly 30 rejected. A result near 40 accepted would mean the distance gate is not seeing the bias and would need investigating before anything is claimed. A result of 0 accepted means antenna 1's truth is not an integer either, which would point at the receiver carrier phase bias (rxCarrierBias.mode 'notImplemented') rather than the inter-antenna term.
_WHATTOREADANDINWHATORDER: summary.stage63Classification first, then nCandidates / nAccepted / nHeld / nRejected, then stage63MaxDistToInt against the 0.20 threshold, and only then position. A fix that lands is only worth having if positionRMS_runwide_m and the last-120 s window improve on best007's 2.0193 m and 0.3182 m AND arcNisOverallPerDof stays conservative. Rounding to a WRONG integer displaces the range by one wavelength, which at 2.450 GHz is 122.4 mm, and it does so silently.
_MONTECARLOISOFFHERE: This is a capability probe, and the ensemble costs 1.5 h. Run it with monteCarlo.enable true only if the fix lands and improves position, because only then is there a covariance claim worth band-checking.
